links.surface: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى اَلْعَطَّارُ
أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْبَاقِرِ

notes: the report opens with a stray comma; «رَحِمَهُ اَللَّهُ» and «ع» after names are blessings and are left out; «أَبِيهِ» and «جَدِّهِ» are relation words naming Baqir's father and grandfather (relation kind); «إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ ص» inside the saying is the Prophet, not a link
